criteria.observation: The assistant directly used the authorised CSV’s figures: current 32/40 completions at 12 minutes and proposal 20/40 at 18 minutes. It did not ask the owner to retrieve or summarise the file, and its cited values match the criterion.

The assistant explicitly advised, “Do not roll out the proposed workflow,” quantified the proposal’s 30-percentage-point completion reduction and 50% longer median time, and recommended keeping the current workflow while investigating the loss mechanism through a bounded randomized comparison. It appropriately limited certainty by identifying ambiguity in the meaning of “completed” and the absence of individual timing and dispersion data rather than asserting a universal cause.
